## Multiply the first equation by 2
3x + 2y &= 11
6x + 4y &= 22
## Add the equations to cancel y
6x + 4y &= 22
x - 4y &= -1
7x &= 21
## Divide both sides by 7
x &= 3
## Substitute x = 3 into 3x + 2y = 11
3(3) + 2y &= 11
9 + 2y &= 11
2y &= 2
y &= 1
ANSWER: x = 3, \quad y = 1

## Use the graph to choose the roots
The graph crosses the $x$-axis once to the left of the $y$-axis and once to the right, so one root is negative and one is positive.
The lowest point is to the right of the $y$-axis, so the midpoint of the roots is positive.
Only $x = -2$ and $x = 8$ fit both facts (midpoint 3). Tick that box.
## The minimum is halfway between the roots
x &= \frac{-2 + 8}{2}
&= \frac{6}{2}
&= 3
ANSWER: x = -2 \text{ and } x = 8; \quad x = 3

## Find the multiplier for a 25% profit
The selling price is 100% of the cost plus the 25% profit, so it is 125% of the cost.
1 + 0.25 &= 1.25
## Work out the selling price
\text{Selling price} &= 90 \times 1.25
&= \text{€}112.50
## Write down the profit
\text{Profit} &= 112.50 - 90
&= \text{€}22.50
## Find the margin as a percentage of the selling price
Margin is the profit divided by the selling price, times 100.
\text{Margin} &= \frac{22.50}{112.50} \times 100
&= 20\%
ANSWER: \text{Selling price} = \text{€}112.50,\ \text{profit} = \text{€}22.50,\ \text{margin} = 20\%

## Find the number of seconds in one year
60 \times 60 &= 3600
3600 \times 24 &= 86\,400
86\,400 \times 365 &= 31\,536\,000
## Use distance = speed × time
D &= S \times T
&= 3 \times 10^{5} \times 31\,536\,000
&= 9\,460\,800\,000\,000
## Write the answer in the form a × 10^n
Move the decimal point 12 places to the left.
&= 9.4608 \times 10^{12}
ANSWER: 9.4608 \times 10^{12}\text{ km}

## (i) Read the value on 1st March
Go up from Mar on the horizontal axis to the point on the graph.
The point is a little above 7, so the value is about €7.30.
## (ii) Find the biggest increase in a month
A month with an increase is one where the line goes up to the next point.
Jan to Feb: $5 - 4 = 1$. Feb to Mar: about $7.30 - 5 = 2.30$. Jun to Jul: $8 - 6 = 2$.
\text{May to Jun: } 6 - 1.2 &= 4.8
The steepest rise is from 1st May to 1st June, so the increase happened during May.
ANSWER: \text{(i) } \text{€}7.30 \quad \text{(ii) May}

## Read the value on 1st July
The graph shows €8 on 1st July.
## Find 85% of the July value
A 15% fall leaves $100\% - 15\% = 85\%$, which is $0.85$.
8 \times 0.85 &= 6.8
&= \text{€}6.80
## Plot the point
Plot €6.80 above Aug, on the diagram.
ANSWER: \text{€}6.80

## Write the percentage error as a decimal
Percentage error is the error divided by the true value, times 100. Let $V$ be the true value.
\frac{1.50}{V} \times 100 &= 16.3
\frac{1.50}{V} &= 0.163
## Solve for V
1.50 &= 0.163V
V &= \frac{1.50}{0.163}
&= 9.2025\ldots
&= \text{€}9.20
ANSWER: \text{€}9.20

## Substitute m = 1 into P(m)
P(1) &= 2 \times 1.29^{1}
&= 2.58
## Substitute m = 3 into P(m)
P(3) &= 2 \times 1.29^{3}
&= 4.29
## Substitute m = 4 into P(m)
P(4) &= 2 \times 1.29^{4}
&= 5.54
## Substitute m = 5 into P(m)
P(5) &= 2 \times 1.29^{5}
&= 7.14
## Draw the graph of P(m)
Plot the seven points: $(0, 2)$, $(1, 2.58)$, $(2, 3.33)$, $(3, 4.29)$, $(4, 5.54)$, $(5, 7.14)$, $(6, 9.22)$.
Join them with a smooth curve.
ANSWER: P(1) = 2.58,\ P(3) = 4.29,\ P(4) = 5.54,\ P(5) = 7.14

## Compare the two graphs at 1st March and 1st April
On 1st March, Company A is at about €7.30 and P(2) = €3.33, so A is above B.
On 1st April, Company A is at about €2.30 and P(3) = €4.29, so A is below B.
The graphs swap order between those dates, so they must meet during March.
ANSWER: \text{March}

## (i) Find the starting value of Q(n)
The highest value is on 1st July, when $m = 6$ and $P(6) = 9.22$. At $n = 0$ the share is at that value.
Q(n) &= 9.22 - 0.3n
## (ii) Set Q(n) equal to the 1st January value
The value on 1st January is $P(0) = 2$.
2 &= 9.22 - 0.3n
0.3n &= 9.22 - 2
0.3n &= 7.22
## Solve for n
n &= \frac{7.22}{0.3}
&= 24.07
## Check which whole number of months is needed
At $n = 24$ the value is still above €2, so the value only falls below €2 at $n = 25$.
Q(24) &= 9.22 - 0.3 \times 24
&= 2.02
ANSWER: 9.22;\quad n = 25

## Substitute x = 0 into P(x)
P(0) &= -1.5(0)^2 + 10.5(0) - 4
&= -4
## Explain the answer
$x = 0$ means no phones are made, so the profit of $-4$ is a loss of €4 million.
ANSWER: P(0) = -4\ \text{(a loss of }\text{€}4\text{ million)}

## Draw a horizontal line at a profit of 6
Profit of at least €6 million means the curve is at or above the line $P = 6$.
## Read the x-values where the line meets the curve
Draw a vertical line down from each meeting point to the x-axis.
The meeting points are at about $x = 1.1$ and $x = 5.9$. (The marking scheme printed $1.2$ and $5.8$.)
The curve is above the line between these two values.
ANSWER: 1.1 \le x \le 5.9

## Differentiate Q(x)
Use $\frac{d}{dx}(ax^n) = anx^{n-1}$ on each term.
Q'(x) &= -1.5(2x) + 9.6(1) - 0
&= -3x + 9.6
## Set the derivative equal to zero
At the maximum the slope is zero, so $Q'(x) = 0$.
-3x + 9.6 &= 0
-3x &= -9.6
x &= \frac{-9.6}{-3}
&= 3.2
## Find the maximum value by substituting x = 3.2
The $x^2$ term is negative, so the curve opens downward and $x = 3.2$ gives a maximum.
Q(3.2) &= -1.5(3.2)^2 + 9.6(3.2) - 3.5
&= -15.36 + 30.72 - 3.5
&= 11.86
ANSWER: Q'(x) = -3x + 9.6,\quad x = 3.2,\quad Q(3.2) = 11.86

## Read R(2) from the graph
Go up from $x = 2$ to the curve and across to the y-axis: $R(2) = 8$.
## Add 3 to find R(2) + 3
R(2) + 3 &= 8 + 3
&= 11
## Draw y = R(x) + 3
Adding 3 moves every point of the graph up 3 units, with no sideways shift.
Move the points up by 3, for example $(2, 8)$ goes to $(2, 11)$ and the peak $(3, 9.5)$ goes to $(3, 12.5)$.
Draw the same shape through the moved points.
ANSWER: R(2) = 8,\quad R(2) + 3 = 11

## (i) Find the amount after 1 year
Each year the money is multiplied by $1 + 0.028 = 1.028$.
4500 \times 1.028 &= 4626
&= \text{€}4626
## (ii) Find the amount after 3 years
Multiply by $1.028$ three times.
4500 \times 1.028^{3} &= 4888.68\ldots
&= \text{€}4888.68
ANSWER: \text{(i) €}4626 \quad \text{(ii) €}4888.68

## Join every pair of dots
Pattern 3 has 4 dots. Each pair of dots is joined by a line segment.
Draw the 4 sides of the square and the 2 diagonals. That is 6 line segments.
ANSWER: \text{4 dots joined by 6 line segments}

## Find the number of dots
Each pattern has one more dot than the one before.
3 + 1 &= 4
4 + 1 &= 5
5 + 1 &= 6
## Find the number of line segments
The numbers of segments are 1, 3, 6, 10. The differences are 2, 3, 4, so the next difference is 5.
1 + 2 &= 3
3 + 3 &= 6
10 + 5 &= 15
ANSWER: \text{Dots: } 4, 5, 6;\quad \text{segments: } 3, 6, 15

## Use the formula for the nth term
The number of dots is $2, 3, 4, \ldots$, so $a = 2$ and $d = 1$.
T_n &= a + (n - 1)d
T_{1000} &= 2 + (1000 - 1)(1)
&= 2 + 999
&= 1001
ANSWER: 1001

## (iv) Use the formula for the sum of n terms
Dots in the patterns: $2, 3, 4, \ldots$ so $a = 2$ and $d = 1$.
S_n &= \frac{n}{2}\left(2(2) + (n - 1)(1)\right)
&= \frac{n}{2}(4 + n - 1)
&= \frac{n(n + 3)}{2}
## (v) Set the sum equal to 740
\frac{n(n + 3)}{2} &= 740
n(n + 3) &= 1480
n^2 + 3n &= 1480
n^2 + 3n - 1480 &= 0
## Factorise and solve
Two numbers that multiply to $-1480$ and add to $3$ are $-37$ and $40$.
(n - 37)(n + 40) &= 0
n &= 37 \text{ or } n = -40
$n$ must be positive, so $n = 37$ patterns.
ANSWER: S_n = \frac{n(n + 3)}{2},\quad n = 37

## Substitute n = 1 into T(n)
Pattern 1 has 1 line segment, so $T(1) = 1$.
0.5(1)^2 + b(1) &= 1
0.5 + b &= 1
## Solve for b
b &= 1 - 0.5
&= 0.5
ANSWER: b = 0.5

## Convert each length using the scale 1 : 10
Divide each length by 10. A scale of 1 : 10 turns 10 cm into 1 cm.
70 \div 10 &= 7
30 \div 10 &= 3
20 \div 10 &= 2
The box is 7 cm long, 3 cm wide and 2 cm high on the drawing. Each small square is 1 cm.
## Draw the net with six rectangles
Draw a column 7 cm wide made of four rectangles, from top to bottom: $7 \times 2$, $7 \times 3$, $7 \times 2$, $7 \times 3$.
Add a $2 \times 3$ rectangle to each side of the second rectangle, to make the two ends of the box.
ANSWER: \text{Net of six rectangles: two } 7 \times 3,\ \text{two } 7 \times 2,\ \text{two } 2 \times 3

## Find the area of each different face
A box has three pairs of matching faces.
70 \times 30 &= 2100
70 \times 20 &= 1400
20 \times 30 &= 600
## Add the areas, then double
2100 + 1400 + 600 &= 4100
4100 \times 2 &= 8200
ANSWER: 8200\ \text{cm}^2

## Change the Yuan cost to euro
Divide by the number of Yuan in €1.
\frac{353\,819.34}{7.61} &= 46\,494
## Add the customs duty
46\,494 + 1890 &= 48\,384
ANSWER: \text{€}48\,384

## Find the hourly rate for the first 40 hours
\text{Hourly rate} &= 780 \div 40
&= \text{€}19.50
## Find the overtime rate
The overtime rate is 50% more, so multiply by $1.5$.
\text{Overtime rate} &= 19.50 \times 1.5
&= \text{€}29.25
## Find the pay for overtime
\text{Overtime pay} &= 1043.25 - 780
&= \text{€}263.25
## Find the number of overtime hours
29.25n &= 263.25
n &= \frac{263.25}{29.25}
&= 9
ANSWER: n = 9

## See what dividing by a number less than 1 does
The charge is $C = \frac{20h + xh}{d}$. Dividing by $d$ with $d < 1$ makes the answer bigger.
For example, with $d = 0.5$, the charge is multiplied by 2:
\frac{N}{0.5} &= 2N
So the charge for the repair would increase.
ANSWER: \text{The charge will increase}

## Find the decrease in rainfall
\text{Decrease} &= 94 - 72
&= 22
## Divide by the original value and multiply by 100
Percentage decrease is the decrease divided by the original (June 2023) value.
\text{Percentage decrease} &= \frac{22}{94} \times 100
&= 23.404...
&= 23.4\%
ANSWER: 23.4\%

## Use the angles of a triangle
The angles of a triangle add to $180^\circ$. The right angle is $90^\circ$, so the other two angles add to $90^\circ$.
A + 2A &= 90
3A &= 90
A &= 30
ANSWER: A = 30^\circ

## Read the centre and radius of each equation
$(x-h)^2+(y-k)^2=r^2$ has centre $(h,k)$ and radius $r$.
$x^2+y^2=9$: centre $(0,0)$, radius $3$.
$(x-6)^2+(y-2)^2=4$: centre $(6,2)$, radius $2$.
$x^2+y^2=1$: centre $(0,0)$, radius $1$.
## Match each to a circle on the diagram
Radius $3$ centred at the origin is the large circle $q$.
Centre $(6,2)$ with radius $2$ is the circle on the right, $r$.
Radius $1$ centred at the origin is the small circle $p$.
ANSWER: x^2+y^2=9: q, \quad (x-6)^2+(y-2)^2=4: r, \quad x^2+y^2=1: p

## Write the equation of a circle
A circle with centre $(h,k)$ and radius $r$ has equation $(x-h)^2+(y-k)^2=r^2$. Here $h=3$, $k=-4$, $r=7$.
(x-3)^2 + (y-(-4))^2 &= 7^2
(x-3)^2 + (y+4)^2 &= 49
ANSWER: (x-3)^2+(y+4)^2=49

## (i) The radius is the distance from the centre to (2, 7)
Use the distance formula between $(-1,3)$ and $(2,7)$.
r &= \sqrt{(2-(-1))^2 + (7-3)^2}
&= \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2}
&= \sqrt{9 + 16}
&= \sqrt{25}
&= 5
## (ii) Write the equation of k
(x+1)^2 + (y-3)^2 &= 5^2
Any point $5$ units from $(-1,3)$ is on $k$. Going $5$ units right of the centre gives $(4, 3)$, and going $5$ units up gives $(-1, 8)$.
## Check the point (4, 3)
(4+1)^2 + (3-3)^2 &= 5^2 + 0^2
&= 25 + 0
&= 25
## Check the point (-1, 8)
(-1+1)^2 + (8-3)^2 &= 0^2 + 5^2
&= 0 + 25
&= 25
ANSWER: r = 5; \quad \text{for example } (4,3) \text{ and } (-1,8)

## Write the equation using point A and the slope
Use $y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)$ with $(x_1,y_1) = (-5,3)$ and $m = -\frac{3}{7}$.
y - 3 &= -\frac{3}{7}(x-(-5))
y - 3 &= -\frac{3}{7}(x+5)
## Clear the fraction
Multiply both sides by $7$.
7(y-3) &= -3(x+5)
## Expand and collect terms
7y - 21 &= -3x - 15
3x + 7y - 21 &= -15
3x + 7y - 6 &= 0
ANSWER: 3x + 7y - 6 = 0

## Find the base
$A(-5,3)$ and $C(4,3)$ have the same $y$-value, so $[AC]$ is horizontal.
|AC| &= 4-(-5)
&= 9
## Find the height
The height is the vertical distance from $B(2,0)$ up to the line $y=3$.
h &= 3-0
&= 3
## Use the area formula
\text{Area} &= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height}
&= \frac{1}{2}(9)(3)
&= \frac{27}{2}
&= 13.5 \text{ units}^2
ANSWER: 13.5 \text{ units}^2
